text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"And now for our next segment!
Twinkle Series Trending News Flash~!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"First up, making waves in last year's Hanshin JF,
and the Mejiro family's much-talked-about promising rookie,
Mejiro Dober-san!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Among fans, expectations and interest are surging regarding Mejiro Dober's campaign along the Tiara route—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since the new year began, the public's attention
towards Mejiro Dober has been growing...
The fervor is far beyond expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether this turns out to be good fortune or bad...
Feeling a bit uneasy, I headed to the academy to discuss our plans for this year with Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the training track,
I spotted Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright doing warm-up exercises together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …………Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober's Trainer,
Happy New Year~.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to you both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober's Trainer,
Happy New Year~.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to you both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Looking forward to working with you this year too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Looking forward to working with you this year, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you this year as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you this year as well~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there she is! It's Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is here with us too...!
Talk about lucky!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
Wh-What is it...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A large crowd of people looking like reporters appeared out of nowhere and came rushing over...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. Are you here for an interview~?
Quite a crowd has gathered, hasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Um, Mejiro Dober!
Do you have a moment?
I'd like to ask about your Classic Year campaign!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the Hanshin JF... Does this mean you're aiming for the Tiara route after all?!
Expectations among the fans are soaring!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Being with Mejiro Bright-san like this, could this be some secret special training for the Classic Year?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Please tell me more details!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: For now, I'll take any questions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"No, we want to hear directly
from Mejiro Dober-san herself!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: The fans would love to hear Dober-san's thoughts directly, so if you wouldn't mind――
choice_data_list: Including that, please make sure to stay true to yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Trainer!
What about what the public thinks?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear~? Goodness! It seems
I have gone and forgotten something~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, over here, over here~!
Please come and help me carry these~."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, wait up, you two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Right? Pretty please, Dober?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Thanks, Bright.
And... well, I guess you too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Thanks, Bright.
And you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, whatever could you mean~?
I was simply having someone accompany me
to retrieve something I left behind, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, whatever could you mean~?
I was simply having someone accompany me
to retrieve something I left behind, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You've got to be kidding me. You said you
came to pick it up, but you're not holding anything right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~ I simply forgot what it was
that I forgot in the first place~♪
I am quite an easygoing sort, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, why was that reporter
acting like that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Nothing like this has ever happened before—
choice_data_list: That's just how much attention you're getting.
That's just how much attention you're getting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Attention...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her run in the Hanshin JF,
it seems like a completely natural progression~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, you performed so splendidly.
It is only natural that all eyes are on you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that... so? Then... will it be like this forever from now on...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now, I wonder about that~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I am sure that from now on, Trainer-sama will
firmly decline any interviews that have not
received prior approval~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Right, dear Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Of course, that's what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems somewhat distracted.
A complete change of pace might be needed here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking "Since it's the New Year...",
what I spontaneously suggested was—
choice_data_list: Let's do our first calligraphy of the year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
W-What are you saying all of a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
W-What's got into you all of a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! Karuta sounds wonderful~!
It feels so lively and perfect for the New Year~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! Karuta sounds wonderful~!
It feels so lively and perfect for the New Year~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, no, Bright! Don't go along with it!
What about the rest of our training!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"How nostalgic~
When the Mejiro family played karuta together, Dober couldn't grab a single card and ended up bursting into tears~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second! That's from way back when I was a tiny kid, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When we did it last year, my results
were way better than Bright's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, was that how it went~?
A year ago is ancient history,
so I don't remember it very well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh... You were the one who brought up the past first...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And with that, our match must be decided right here and now♪
Come along, Dober, let us begin~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez... Fine, I get it!
I just have to do it, right? Do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, Trainer-sama,
please be our reader~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since I'm doing this, I'm not gonna lose~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so,
I was able to successfully refresh my mind."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Why so suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! Ozoni is so wonderful and fitting for the New Year.
I was just starting to feel hungry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Streeeetchy mochi! Let's eat!
Ehehe, it makes me smile so much~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Wait, aren't we going to train—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go shopping right away~.
Now then, what ingredients do we need for ozoni...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...What kind of vegetables were in it again~?
Celery?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez...! Stop, Bright!
If you're making it, I'll help you out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't just zone out over there!
You're the one who brought this up, so make yourself useful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That said, it's not like I'm super confident in my skills either...
Trainer, would you give me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I helped the two of them make
Mejiro-style ozoni soup, and we all enjoyed
eating it together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I helped the two of them make
Mejiro-style ozoni soup, and we all enjoyed
eating it together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It served as a good change of pace for Mejiro Dober,
and getting a taste of the Mejiro family's culinary traditions made it a fine start to the new year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
F-First calligraphy of the year?
Where's this coming from all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
F-First calligraphy of the year?
Were we just talking about that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! First calligraphy of the year sounds lovely~.
I haven't gotten around to doing mine yet~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! First calligraphy of the year sounds lovely~.
I haven't gotten around to doing mine yet~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober. Since we have the chance,
would you like to write down our goals for the year together~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Putting our resolve into writing will surely fire us up for training even more~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I don't mind doing it.
Writing it together is kinda embarrassing, though.
My handwriting isn't very good, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What matters most in calligraphy is the heart.
Don't worry, simply pour your true feelings into the brush and you'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get started right away~!
Please join in as well, Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us wrote down our goals
for the Classic Year and showed them to each other...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seemed able to concentrate too,
and a bit of her drive returned to the words 'Triple Tiara Achieved'.
